ta_read.text: CRWV's daily swings show lower highs and lower lows; the last structure break was down on Nov 4, when it closed below $51.24. On weekly bars it is in a downtrend (below its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show mixed swings (a range).

The nearest support zone is $50.42–$52.06, where price turned 1 times, most recently on Oct 26; the nearest resistance zone is $60.55–$64.39, where price turned 3 times, most recently on Oct 29, a former support that flipped to resistance.
Over the last 60 sessions it has moved in a falling channel (fit R² 0.73) and sits in the upper half of the channel.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 8 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 4 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-6.1%) came on light volume.
RSI is 43 (neutral), with a bullish divergence on Nov 5: price made a lower low but RSI made a higher one: selling momentum is fading; MACD is above its signal line since Nov 11.
A daily close above $64.39 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $50.42 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.
